_comment: Venues for the withdrawal-ability recorder (scripts/record-venue-liquidity.mjs). These are EXTERNAL mainnet venues (Ethereum), read via RECORDER_RPC_URL — NOT the local anvil. Entry shape: {name, kind, address, underlying?, decimals, enabled, newsQuery?, notes, depthMarkets?, depthCoveredByInstant?}. Only enabled=true venues are recorded. Never guess an address; leave it empty and enabled=false until verified. newsQuery (optional) is the Google News RSS search string for scripts/fetch-venue-news.mjs — a plain-English venue name, NOT a ticker, so headlines are about the protocol, not a random symbol collision.
_comment_depth: depthMarkets (optional) = the DEPTH-VS-BOOK extension (memo P4, docs/research/worst-carry-venues.md §3). Each entry {name, kind:'curve-stableswap'|'uniswap-v3', address, token0, token1, exitFrom, enabled, note}. token0/token1 are the pool's coins(0)/coins(1) (curve) or token0()/token1() (univ3). exitFrom = the token a holder is exiting (venue token, or its UNDERLYING when the venue token itself has no deep pool); the EXITABLE depth the recorder sums is the OTHER side (the tokens you swap INTO). EVERY address is on-chain-verified (coins/token reads) before enabled=true — a candidate that fails verification stays enabled=false with a note, never guessed. depthCoveredByInstant=true (aave) means the venue's instant_usd read already IS its depth, so no pool is needed. A venue with neither an enabled depthMarket nor depthCoveredByInstant keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list (silence there is a blind spot, not all-clear).

venues.name: sUSDe
venues.notes: Ethena Staked USDe (mainnet). underlying = USDe. Reads: cooldownDuration() uint24, totalAssets(), totalSupply(), silo() if present. cooling/stranded split is venue-specific and NOT fabricated here — raw params stored, instant_usd left null with a note.

depthMarkets.name: DOLA/sUSDe (Curve stableswap-ng)
depthMarkets.note: VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06: coins(0)=DOLA (symbol DOLA, 18dec), coins(1)=sUSDe (symbol sUSDe, 18dec); balances ~$40.8M DOLA / ~$12.4M sUSDe (~$53M TVL). NO deep sUSDe/USDe or sUSDe/USDC Curve or Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry scan: best sUSDe/USDC is ~$718 dust). This DOLA/sUSDe pool is sUSDe's DEEPEST secondary (instant-exit) market. exitFrom=sUSDe ⇒ exitable depth = the DOLA side (swap sUSDe INTO DOLA), valued $1/stable as a stated assumption (DOLA is Inverse Finance's stablecoin).

venues.name: aave-v3-usde
venues.notes: aEthUSDe, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: Aave V3 Pool (0x87870Bca…4fA4E2).getReserveData(USDe) returned this address; it answers symbol()='aEthUSDe' and UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS()=USDe. instant liquidity = USDe.balanceOf(aToken) at $1/stable (assumption recorded in params). depthCoveredByInstant=true: for an aToken the instant_usd read (underlying held by the aToken) IS the exitable depth, so no secondary pool is needed and 'depth_vs_book' is NOT on this venue's uncovered list.

venues.name: sUSDS
venues.notes: Sky Savings USDS, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: symbol()='sUSDS', asset()=USDS (0xdC03…384F), totalAssets ~$4.7B at verification. No cooldown method — those reads fail gracefully and raw 4626 state (totalAssets/totalSupply) is what gets recorded.

depthMarkets.name: USDS/USDC (none deep enough — UNVERIFIED, not enabled)
depthMarkets.note: NO verifiable deep USDS/USDC (or sUSDS) Curve/Uni-v3 pool exists on mainnet (Curve registry + DeFiLlama scan 2026-09-06: best USDS/USDC Curve pool ~$4k dust). Deep USDS DEX liquidity lives in Uniswap v4 (PYUSD-USDS ~$100M, USDT-USDS ~$50M) — a singleton PoolManager the reader cannot address by pool contract — and Sky's PSM (a peg-stability module, not an AMM). Left enabled:false: never guess an address. Consequence: sUSDS keeps 'depth_vs_book' on its uncovered list until a v4-capable reader or a verified curve/univ3 pool is added.

venues.name: scrvUSD
venues.notes: Curve Savings crvUSD, VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-02: symbol()='scrvUSD', asset()=crvUSD (0xf939…1b4E), totalAssets ~$15.8M at verification. Same graceful-read behavior as sUSDS.

depthMarkets.name: crvUSD/USDC (Curve stableswap-ng plain, factory-crvusd-0)
depthMarkets.note: VERIFIED on-chain 2026-09-06: coins(0)=USDC (symbol USDC, 6dec), coins(1)=crvUSD (symbol crvUSD, 18dec); balances ~$14.5M USDC / ~$12.3M crvUSD (~$26.8M TVL). scrvUSD (the venue token) has NO deep secondary pool, so this entry covers the UNDERLYING crvUSD's exit: exitFrom=crvUSD ⇒ exitable depth = the USDC side. A deeper crvUSD/USDT pool (~$37.7M, 0x390f3595bCa2Df7d23783dFd126427CCeb997BF4) exists but is left unverified/not-added here; add later if the extra depth is wanted.
